name: Hotel Bristol, Warsaw
positioning: Historic hotel on Warsaw's Royal Route, next to the Presidential Palace, first opened in 1901 and officially Hotel Bristol, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Warsaw
best_for: Travelers who want a historic, Art Nouveau landmark within walking distance of the Old Town and the Royal Castle
Guests interested in Polish history, including those exploring their Polish ancestry

facts.text: The hotel is in Warsaw's city center on the Royal Route, next to the Presidential Palace.
The hotel is within walking distance of the Old Town, the Royal Castle, the National Museum, the National Theater and the Opera House.
Hotel Bristol welcomed its first guest in November 1901.
The pianist, composer and statesman Ignacy Jan Paderewski was a co-founder of the hotel.
The hotel was designed by Władysław Marconi, with Art Nouveau interiors by Otto Wagner Jr.
In 1965 Hotel Bristol was entered into the register of historic monuments.
In 1919 Paderewski, as Prime Minister, had his political office in what is now the Paderewski Suite.
Over the decades the hotel has welcomed nearly all Polish Nobel Prize winners.
Mahogany-framed windows in the rooms open to views that include the Royal Route, city parks, the Presidential Palace and the hotel courtyard.
Bristol Spa has a heated indoor swimming pool, a gym, a sauna, a steam bath and treatment rooms.
Bristol Spa treatments use products from the British brand AMRA.

highlights.text: The Paderewski Suite is furnished with original antiques from the early 20th century.
The Bristol Genealogist service offers professional consultancy for guests exploring their Polish ancestry.
Every day the Concierge Team leads guests on a guided tour of the hotel.
Café Bristol has served patisseries in its original Viennese-style interiors since 1901.

considerations.text: The hotel has limited parking spaces.
WhataHotel notes the historic building may have smaller room sizes than modern hotels.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning and prime location.
